features.title: Sized for two, made for sharing
features.text: Ample space allows two people to sit side by side, creating the perfect spot for long conversations, lazy Sundays, or cozy TV evenings together.

features.title: Pocket-spring bounce that lasts longer
features.text: Springs wrapped in foam create buoyant comfort that doesn’t sag, so every sit feels fresh and supportive even after years of use.

features.title: Elegant stitchwork that elevates style
features.text: Neat stitching gives a tailored look, making the sofa a polished piece that adds subtle sophistication to your room.

features.title: Fabric that feels soft on your skin
features.text: Smooth camel fabric stays gentle and breathable, ensuring comfort whether you’re lounging on hot afternoons or cool evenings.

features.title: Camel tone that soothes your space
features.text: The warm earthy hue makes your room feel calmer and more welcoming, pairing beautifully with both modern and rustic décor.
